matches.title: 元宝-后台开发工程师

Location: 深圳

3.负责解决平台和服务在高并发场景下的性能优化，问题定位&解决，保障服务SLA。

Business Group: CSIG
matches.reasoning: 田瑞琦在AI/LLM后台开发方向具备较强的技术基础，尤其是RAG系统、LangChain/LangGraph、FastAPI等与岗位高度相关的技术栈，与腾讯元宝AIGC平台的核心需求有较好的契合度。然而，候选人目前仍处于实习/在读阶段，缺乏高并发、大规模分布式后台系统的生产级工程经验，且对Kafka、微服务治理、服务SLA保障等企业级后台能力的实践深度不足。教育背景优秀（清华硕士+浙大本科），深圳地点与候选人偏好匹配，但薪资期望（30-60万美元）远超国内市场水平，存在较大落差。
strengths: 具备生产级RAG系统开发经验，使用LangChain LCEL、混合检索（BM25+BGE-M3）、Milvus、FlashRank重排序，检索精度提升35%，与元宝AIGC平台核心需求高度吻合
熟悉LLM大模型应用开发，有LangGraph多Agent流水线设计经验，支持质量门控路由，契合AI Agent研发上线需求
后端技术栈完整：FastAPI、Docker、PostgreSQL、Redis、WebSocket、REST API，具备构建高性能后���服务的基础能力
有AIGC评估流水线（RAGAS）和自动化测试（80%+覆盖率）经验，有助于数据飞轮pipeline建设
清华大学计算机科学硕士（GPA 3.9）+ 浙江大学计算机工程学士（GPA 3.7），顶尖学历背景
深圳在候选人偏好城市列表中，地点完全匹配
有AWS、Azure云平台经验，以及Kafka技术栈，具备云原生后台开发基础
发表ACM MM '23论文，具备AI研究与工程结合的能力
missing_skills: 高并发分布式后台系统设计与优化经验（如百万级QPS、微服务治理、服务网格）
生产级服务SLA保障与故障定位经验（监控告警、链路追踪、容量规划）
大规模数据飞轮pipeline工程实践（特征工程、数据标注平台、在线学习）
插件接入与管理平台开发经验（Plugin系统架构设计）
音视频对话后台系统开发经验（流媒体、实时通信协议如WebRTC/RTMP）
腾讯系技术栈（如tRPC、TDW、TDSQL等）或同等大厂后台中间件经验
Go语言（腾讯后台开发主流语言）
interview_talking_points: 重点介绍第三科技研究院的生产级RAG系统项目：强调混合检索架构设计决策（BM25+BGE-M3）、35%精度提升的量化成果、Docker Compose部署与Redis语义缓存的工程实践，体现后台系统设计能力
展示AI Agent LangGraph项目中的多Agent协作架构设计，说明质量门控路由机制如何提升Agent研发质量，与元宝AI Agent平台建设需求直接对标

主动承认高并发分布式系统经验不足，但可结合Redis缓存、SSE流式传输、FastAPI异步处理等实践，说明对低延迟服务设计的理解，并表达快速学习意愿
提及Kafka技术栈经验，结合AIGC平台的消息队列需求，说明对事件驱动架构的理解
清华+浙大顶尖学历背景，以及ACM MM '23论文发表经历，体现AI工程与研究的双重能力，适合腾讯CSIG的技术氛围

matches.title: AI Engineer
matches.description:
Title: AI Engineer
Company: Cloudflare
Location: Hybrid
Description: <div class="content-intro"><div><strong>About Us</strong></div> <div> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us!&nbsp;</span></p> </div></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX&nbsp;</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Emerging Technologies &amp; Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>In this role you will design, build, and ship AI-powered product features.
